thread:
nora_csm: FYI during the weekly account-health sweep billing-bot surfaced an overcommit for Polaris (hosted). flag looks like a short, high-volume burst vs steady drift. can we triage quickly?

billing-bot: ALERT: account=polaris-inc | commit_alloc=150000 | usage=422000 | utilization=281% | window=72h | top_route=/v1/chat/completions | dashboard=https://app.redwood.com/d/polaris/billing?ts=1755551200 :warning:

luke_fin: thanks. what's the estimated dollar impact and did it hit any quota caps?

nora_csm: pulled the billing snapshot: 
```
commit_tokens: 150000
usage_tokens: 422000
overage_tokens: 272000
est_overage_usd: $1,088
period: 2025-03-18..2025-03-21
```
note: hosted gen only; embeddings on a separate billing stream.

tanya_sre: checked telemetry 15p latency and 5xx rates stable. no recent deploys. looks traffic-originated. I spotted a repeat POST pattern from a single API key between 03:00-06:00 UTC yesterday.

kevin_csm: I messaged the customer contact earlier 14: asked whether they ran a canary or a load-job and if they used prod key. awaiting reply.

luke_fin: if this was accidental we should consider a partial one-time credit + a hard cap option going forward. i'll sketch two options: 50% credit vs credit up to commit. both with note that repeated incidents won't be covered.

tanya_sre: short-term mitigation: we can enable a soft token-rate limit for polaris on /v1/chat/completions (e.g., token/s ceiling) and a hard-days-per-week budget cap. i can stage the soft limit for 3 hours while we confirm.

nora_csm: please stage the soft limit now. i'll keep chasing our contact and request job IDs and timestamps. also scheduling a customer health sync tomorrow.

billing-bot: FLAG: status=ACKNOWLEDGED | owner=nora_csm | incident_ref=INC-175555 | trace=https://app.redwood.com/trace/INC-175555

kevin_csm: polaris replied: they ran a load script from CI and accidentally used the prod key. they shared a job id (job-8873) and logs. they apologized and asked for the breakdown before the call.

luke_fin: preparing two-line cost memo for the call with both credit scenarios and a small appendix showing per-route token counts. will share by EOD.

tanya_sre: soft-limit applied at 1755551400 (token cap ~1200 tok/s effective) and scheduled to auto-remove at 1755552600. added alert if traffic exceeds 90% of cap.

nora_csm: action checklist updated in thread: 1) nora -> send cost memo and call invite; 2) luke -> draft credit options and accounting note; 3) tanya -> keep soft-limit and monitors; 4) kevin -> prep onboarding note suggesting sandbox usage for stress tests.

billing-bot: RESOLVE: incident=INC-175555 | resolution=pending-customer-sync | owner=nora_csm

kevin_csm: follow-up ask for product team: can we add a prominent reminder in onboarding and a small checkbox in the UI when creating API keys: "Intended use: production / sandbox / integration" ? reduces accidental prod key usage.

nora_csm: agreed. i'm adding the onboarding blurb and will push a feature request to product. wrapping up here until the sync :white_check_mark:
